PREF-01.where: page Game folder (Start page, settings file); sub/file.server.js gameOpt
PREF-01.note: The game folder is the page's own setting, shared by every tab; no second copy here.

PREF-02.where: page Mod button (setMod), core open (mod over game)
PREF-02.note: One mod folder over the game, picked at the top of the page; SOEdit takes five mod folders for name lookup. Missing: more than one mod layer for the lookup (the core's sceneload takes mods, the page passes one).

PREF-03.note: The page's own folder and file picker.

PREF-04.note: Author name pref, filled from the Windows user name when empty (as SOEdit does), used by the header stamp.

PREF-05.test: model-edit-file.test.js: header stamp keeps other comments; text view; info; file.test.js ok 4
PREF-05.note: Read-only header line: made by, exported by, meshes by, volumes by, date, file, rebuilt by, last build.

PREF-06.note: The 3D view shows and hides volumes, entities, obstacles and areas by kind, but has no separate switch for the RAM volume, track volumes and lamps, and no pref is kept for them. Missing: those three switches.

PREF-07.where: sub/file.client.js PREFS fov; sub/viewer.client.js readPrefs, hookPrefs
PREF-07.note: Field of view kept in the settings, clamped 20 to 120, default 60; the 3D view reads it and follows a change at once. The grid size pref works the same way.

PREF-08.note: Colours follow the page light and dark theme (CSS variables, read again when the theme changes). There is no per-element colour editor for SOEdit's 21 elements. Missing: a colour pref per element, if wanted.

PREF-09.where: sub/file.client.js:19 pget / pset, LS keys models.pref.<name> (settings file /api/settings)
PREF-09.note: Kept in the ARSENAL settings file as each one changes (not only at exit). Prefs: author, stamp, gemi, backup, confirmSave, confirmRemove, autosave, recentMax, newFolder, exportFolder, units, grid, snapMove, snapTurn, fov. Language follows the page. Units, grid and snap are offered through EXT_SCREENS.models.prefs for the view and gizmo parts to read.

PREF-10.where: sub/file.client.js:43 addRecent (on the core's open event)
PREF-10.note: LS models.recent keeps target and mod folder, newest first.
